headline: Physical therapist at First Rehabilitation of North Palm Beach

on_the_show: Logan sat down with Dave and Mike to talk about what modern physical therapy looks like beyond the stretches and exercises most people expect. He covered how the right movement, at the right time, restores strength and confidence after an injury, and why the relationship between therapist and patient sits at the heart of every successful recovery.

background.text: He is a Doctor of Physical Therapy at First Rehabilitation of North Palm Beach, dedicated to helping patients move and feel their best with hands on, one on one care.
